# Comcast Corporate

> > Official corporate communications from Comcast, featuring company news, product innovation, community impact initiatives, and leadership insights from Brian Roberts and the executive team.

This site serves as Comcast's primary corporate communications hub, covering the company's business services, consumer products like Xfinity TV and X1 Platform, philanthropic programs including Comcast Cares Day, and workplace culture initiatives. Content highlights partnerships with NBCUniversal, community engagement through United Way, and innovations in broadband technology and home automation.

## Key Topics

- Comcast
- NBCUniversal
- Xfinity TV and X1 Platform
- Brian Roberts (CEO)
- Comcast Business Services
- Comcast Cares Day
- Community Impact and Corporate Philanthropy
- United Way Partnership
- Philadelphia Headquarters and Comcast Center
- Broadband and Network Innovation
- Xfinity Home Automation
- Corporate Equality and Inclusion
- Video On Demand
- David Cohen (Executive Leadership)
- Startup and Venture Partnerships

- [The New X1 Experience: A Customer-Centric Approach](https://corporate.comcast.com/comcast-voices/the-new-x1-experience-a-customer-centric-approach): X1 Platform development and customer-centric UX design approach
- [Comcast CEO Brian Roberts Demonstrates 1Gbps Speed Broadband Connection and Next Generation Video Product](https://corporate.comcast.com/comcast-voices/comcast-ceo-brian-robert-demonstrates-1gbps-speed-broadband-connection-and-next-generation-video-pro): Brian Roberts demos 1Gbps broadband and next-gen video at NCTA Chicago
- [The Evolution of Xfinity Home](https://corporate.comcast.com/comcast-voices/the-evolution-of-xfinity-home): Xfinity Home cloud-based security and home automation product evolution
- [Accelerating Product Innovation: Introducing CIM Lab Week](https://corporate.comcast.com/comcast-voices/accelerating-product-innovation-introducing-cim-lab-week): Comcast Interactive Media launches CIM Lab Week hackathon program
- [Watch](https://corporate.comcast.com/comcast-voices/watch-generation-next-leveraging-the-network-for-a-new-era-of-innovation): CEO Brian Roberts discusses cable industry future at NCTA 2011
- [Primetime Shifts to Bedtime for Downloadable Content](https://corporate.comcast.com/comcast-voices/primetime-shifts-to-bedtime-for-downloadable-content): Analysis of Xfinity TV customer viewing habits for downloadable content
